labels.title: Vital Nutrients Ginkgo

fields.other_ingredients: Rice Powder, Vegetable Cellulose Capsule, Magnesium Citrate, Leucine, and Silica.

labels.notes: Source: NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD), label ID 6861, https://api.ods.od.nih.gov/dsld/s3/pdf/6861.pdf

labels.title: Jarrow Formulas Ginkgo Biloba

fields.other_ingredients: Cellulose, magnesium stearate (vegetable source) and silicon dioxide. Capsule consists of hydroxypropylmethylcellulose.

labels.notes: Source: NIH DSLD, label ID 37759, https://api.ods.od.nih.gov/dsld/s3/pdf/37759.pdf. Dose is per serving of 2 capsules.

labels.title: Jarrow Formulas Ginkgo Biloba Veggie Caps

fields.other_ingredients: Cellulose, magnesium stearate (vegetable source) and silicon dioxide. Capsule consists of hydroxypropylmethylcellulose.

labels.notes: Source: NIH DSLD, label ID 200314, https://api.ods.od.nih.gov/dsld/s3/pdf/200314.pdf. Dose is per serving of 2 capsules.

labels.title: Douglas Laboratories Ginkgo Biloba Max-V
labels.notes: Source: NIH DSLD, label ID 9633, https://api.ods.od.nih.gov/dsld/s3/pdf/9633.pdf. Also contains Ginkgo biloba (leaf) 150 mg, non-standardized.

labels.title: Herbal Authority Ginkgo Leaf Extract

fields.other_ingredients: Vegetable Glycerin, Water, Natural Caramel Color.

labels.notes: Source: NIH DSLD, label ID 1736, https://api.ods.od.nih.gov/dsld/s3/pdf/1736.pdf. Alcohol free: alcohol removed after extraction, glycerin base; 500 mg dried herb equivalent per 1 mL.

labels.title: Botanic Choice St. John's Wort

labels.notes: Source: NIH DSLD, label ID 77053, https://api.ods.od.nih.gov/dsld/s3/pdf/77053.pdf. Front panel text is printed sideways.
